DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お届けの品物ですね。この袋ごと拾われたのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are handing in this item, correct? Did you find it together with this bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 拾ったのはスマートフォンだけです。持ってくるために私の袋へ入れましたが、自分の充電ケーブルも中に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 拾ったのは電話だけで運搬袋と中のケーブルは自分の物と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I found only the smartphone. I put it in my bag to bring it here, but my own charging cable is also inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish the found phone from your transport bag and cable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: では、拾った電話と、お客様のケーブルを分けて確認しましょう。ケーブルは、拾う前から袋にあったものですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Then let us check the found phone separately from your cable. Was the cable in the bag before you found it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、朝から入れていました。黒い袋も私のものです。電話には触らず、自分の物だけ出してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ケーブルが発見前から私物だったと答え分けてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, it has been there since this morning. The black bag is mine too. May I take out only my belongings without touching the phone?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say the cable was yours before the discovery and ask to separate it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで中を確認してからお示しします。この白いケーブルがお客様のものでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check inside and show you. Is this white cable yours?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうです。根元に私のイニシャルを書いてあります。電話と一緒に落ちていたケーブルではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 提示されたケーブルの目印を確認し電話と共に拾った物ではないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. My initials are written near its base. It was not a cable lying together with the phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Identify your cable's marking and explain it was not found with the phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かりました。ケーブルと袋はお返しします。電話を拾った場所と時刻を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We will return the cable and bag. Where and when did you find the phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 公園の水飲み場の横で、二時十五分ごろです。拾ってから画面を開いたり、持ち主を調べたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 拾得場所時刻と未操作を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Beside the park's drinking fountain, around2:15. Since finding it I have not opened the screen or tried to identify the owner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the discovery location and time and say you have not operated it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その状態で電話をお預かりします。お名前と連絡先も伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will take the phone in that condition. We will also ask your name and contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 記入します。私の袋とケーブルは持ち帰り、拾った電話だけをこちらへお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡先を記入し私物を受け取り拾得電話のみ引き渡すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will fill them in. I will take my bag and cable home and hand over only the found phone here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in contact details, recover your belongings and hand over only the found phone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 電話をお預かりしました。お返しした私物も忘れずにお持ちください。ご協力ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received the phone. Please remember the personal items we returned. Thank you for your cooperation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転送を申し込んだ後のお荷物が心配とのことですね。追跡番号はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are concerned about a parcel after requesting forwarding, correct? Do you have its tracking number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、友人が旧住所へ送った荷物です。転送は申し込んだのに、友人から届いた画面には旧住所のまま載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送申込み後も友人の荷物の画面が旧住所なので配達先を心配すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, a friend sent it to my old address. I requested forwarding, but the screen my friend sent still shows the old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Express concern about delivery because your friend's parcel screen still shows the old address after requesting forwarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その画面は、発送したときの送り先を示していますか。それとも現在の配達状況の画面でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does that screen show the shipping address when dispatched, or the current delivery status?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人が送ってくれた送り状の写真でした。追跡の画面だと思っていましたが、そこには配達の状態は書いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 見ていたのは現在追跡でなく発送時の送り状写真だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was a photo of the shipping label my friend sent. I thought it was a tracking screen, but it does not show delivery status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself: it was a shipping-label photo, not current tracking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送り状の住所だけでは、今どこへ向かっているかは分かりません。この番号で配送の担当へ照会しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: The label address alone cannot tell us where it is heading now. Let us ask the delivery staff using this number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。この番号で今の状況を確認してください。転送の申込みの控えも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 追跡番号で個別荷物の現在状況を確認してもらい転送申込み控えも示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Please check its current status with this number. I will also show my forwarding request receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check this parcel's current status by tracking number and show the forwarding request receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、個別のお荷物について確認します。旧住所では、今もどなたかが受け取れる状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, we will check this individual parcel. Is someone still able to receive it at your old address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 元の同居人がいます。私の荷物が届いていないか聞いて、こちらでも照会してもらっていると知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧住所の同居人に届いていないか尋ね照会中と知らせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: My former housemate is there. I will ask whether my parcel has arrived and tell them you are also checking here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the old-address housemate whether it arrived and tell them an inquiry is underway. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当へは転送の申込みをしたことと、旧住所に同居人が残っていることを分けて伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We will separately tell the staff that you requested forwarding and that a housemate remains at the old address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。友人にも新住所を改めて知らせます。今回の荷物については、確認できてから連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 友人に新住所を知らせ今回の荷物は確認後に連絡すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I will tell my friend my new address again. About this parcel, I will contact them after confirming what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell your friend the new address and explain you will report on this parcel after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの追跡番号で確認を進めます。送り状の写真と転送申込みの控えは、お手元に残しておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will proceed using this tracking number. Keep the label photo and forwarding request receipt with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 登録情報の変更ですね。記入していて分からない所はございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change your registered details, correct? Is anything unclear while filling in the form?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住所が変わりました。この用紙には勤務先の欄もあって、引っ越したので全部書き直すのか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更用紙の勤務先欄も書き直す必要があるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: My address changed. This form also has an employer field, and I am unsure whether moving means I must rewrite everything.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the employer field on the address-change form must also be rewritten. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先も変わりましたか。変わった内容を順に伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your employer changed too? We will ask about changes in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 仕事は同じ会社のままです。会社から遠くなりましたが、勤務先の住所自体は変わっていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 会社は変わらず自宅が遠くなっただけと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I still work for the same company. I now live farther away, but the workplace address itself has not changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the company is unchanged and only your home is farther away. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、ご自宅の住所変更として確認します。電話番号にも変更はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then we will check this as a home-address change. Has your phone number changed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 番号は同じです。ここを空欄にすると、電話もなくなったように見えるかもしれないので、記入方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 電話も同じで空欄の意味が不安なため書き方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is the same. Leaving this blank might make it look as if I no longer have a phone, so please explain how to fill it in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the phone is unchanged and ask how to fill it in because a blank worries you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 変更のない項目の書き方は、担当と一緒に確認できます。説明を聞いてからご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check how to enter unchanged items with the staff. Please listen to the explanation before writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。今の住所の書類はこちらです。会社と電話は変更なしと分かるようにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人住所資料を出し勤務先と電話を変更なしと明示したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. Here is a document for my current address. I want it to be clear that my company and phone are unchanged.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your address document and say you want employer and phone marked unchanged. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その内容を担当へ伝えます。変更した住所は、建物名と部屋番号もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will tell the staff. Please also check the building name and room number in your new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 部屋番号まで合っています。自宅住所だけが変わり、勤務先と電話は同じと伝えて、該当欄を確認して記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号を確認し変更項目を自宅住所だけにして記入相談すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Even the room number is correct. I will explain that only my home address changed, while employer and phone are the same, and check the relevant fields before filling them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm the room number and decide to consult on entering only the changed home address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類と用紙を担当にお出しください。変更する項目を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please give the staff your document and form. We will check the items to change together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 飲物について、何をご確認になりたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: What would you like to check about the drinks?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 甘くないものを探しています。この「砂糖不使用」は、甘くないという意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 甘くない飲物を探し砂糖不使用が味も甘くない意味か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for something that is not sweet. Does “no sugar used” mean that it does not taste sweet?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether no sugar used also means no sweet taste while looking for an unsweet drink. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 砂糖を使っていないという表示です。この商品の原材料には、甘味料が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: It means sugar was not used. This product's ingredients list includes a sweetener.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 甘い味は付いているんですね。砂糖の有無ではなく、甘くない味のものを買いたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 甘味料を知り砂糖有無より甘くない味を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: So it does have a sweet taste. I want a drink that does not taste sweet, rather than simply one without sugar.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Having learned about sweeteners, prefer a non-sweet taste rather than merely no sugar. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それでしたら、こちらの無糖のお茶も候補になります。香りのお好みはございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then this unsweetened tea is also an option. Do you have a preference for its aroma?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 強い香りはあまり好きではありません。隣の果物の絵のあるお茶は、果汁入りか、香りだけかも分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 香りの好みを伝え果物の絵の飲物の果汁と香りの違いを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I do not like strong aromas much. Can you also tell whether the tea beside it with a fruit picture has juice or only fragrance?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: State your aroma preference and ask about juice versus fragrance in the drink with a fruit picture. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この商品の原材料表示では、果汁ではなく香料があります。もう一方は、茶葉と水が記載されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Its ingredients list has flavouring rather than fruit juice. The other one lists tea leaves and water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 絵だけでは中身が分かりませんね。果物の香りも今回は避けたいので、茶葉と水のほうを見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原材料の違いを理解し果物香料も避け茶葉と水を選ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The picture alone cannot tell what is inside. I want to avoid fruit fragrance this time too, so I will look at the tea leaves and water one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand the ingredient difference and choose tea leaves and water to avoid fruit flavouring too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの商品です。容量も、ご希望の量に合うかご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is this product. Please also see whether the volume suits your needs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この量で大丈夫です。甘味料のある飲物ではなく、果物の香料もないこちらのお茶を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 容量を確認し甘味料と果物香料のない候補を買うと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: This amount is fine. I will choose this tea without fruit flavouring, rather than a drink containing sweetener.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the volume and decide to buy the option without sweeteners or fruit flavouring. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらのお茶ですね。お会計へどうぞ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: This tea, then. Please proceed to the checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お散歩からお戻りですか。何かお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you back from a walk? Are you looking for something?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 飲物を買いたいんですが、財布を家族のバッグに入れたままでした。この自動販売機はスマホでも払えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 財布を家族に預けたままのため販売機のスマホ決済可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want to buy a drink, but left my wallet in my family member's bag. Can I pay with a smartphone at this vending machine?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether smartphone payment is possible because your wallet is still with family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この機械の支払い表示には現金のみとあります。水飲み場でしたら、こちらにもあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This machine's payment sign says cash only. There is also a drinking fountain here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 現金だけですね。今は水飲み場を使いたいです。顔も洗っていい所か、飲むための蛇口だけか分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現金のみと理解し水飲み場の用途を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Cash only, then. I want to use the fountain now. Do you know if washing my face is allowed or if the tap is only for drinking?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand cash only and ask what the fountain may be used for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらは飲用の蛇口です。手洗い用の設備は、隣の建物側にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: This tap is for drinking. Handwashing facilities are on the adjacent building side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 飲用と手洗いを分けて使います。家族は遊具の近くなので、そこで合流して財布を受け取ることにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 飲用と手洗いを分け家族の所へ財布を受け取りに戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will use the drinking and washing facilities separately. My family is near the playground equipment, so I will meet them there and get my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate drinking and handwashing and say you will return to family for your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 遊具へは、広場の外側の園路をお使いください。中央には催しの準備で荷物があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use the park path around the outside of the square to reach the playground. There are supplies in the middle for event preparations.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 外側を通ります。先に家族へ連絡して、財布を持ってどこかへ探しに来てもらうより、私が戻ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 迂回園路を使い家族を探しに来させず自分が移動すると連絡する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will go around the outside. I will contact my family first and say I will come back, rather than ask them to bring the wallet and come looking for me somewhere.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Use the outer detour and tell family you will move rather than have them search for you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そのほうが行き違いを避けられますね。水飲み場はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: That should avoid missing each other. The fountain is here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水を飲んでから外側の園路で家族の所へ戻ります。家族には、遊具のそばで待っていてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先に水を飲み外側を通って家族の待機場所へ戻ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will drink water, then follow the outer path back to my family. I will ask them to wait beside the playground equipment.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to drink first, take the outer path and return to where family waits. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、こちらの蛇口をご利用ください。園路では、作業中の荷物にもお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, use this tap. Be careful of the supplies being worked with along the path too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホームまでご案内が必要でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you need directions to the platform?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 階段を使わない道を知りたいです。大きいスーツケースが二つあって、友人と一つずつ持っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同行者と大荷物二つで階段を避ける経路を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like a route without stairs. We have two large suitcases, and my friend and I each have one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for a stair-free route with your companion and two large bags. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この先のエレベーターをご利用いただけます。入口は狭いので、荷物の幅もご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can use the elevator ahead. Its entrance is narrow, so check your luggage width too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私だけ先に荷物を二つ運んで、友人に後から来てもらうつもりでした。でも、一人で二つ持つと動きにくいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人で二つ運ぶ案は動きにくいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I planned to take both bags ahead alone and have my friend follow, but carrying two by myself makes moving difficult.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that carrying both bags alone would make moving difficult. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 無理にまとめず、お二人で一つずつ持って進まれてはいかがでしょう。今のご予定には時間の余裕がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Rather than forcing them together, why not each carry one and go together? Do you have time to spare?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 出発まで三十分あります。一つずつ持って二人で動きます。エレベーターに同時に入れなかったら、降りた所で待ち合わせてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 余裕時間を伝え一人一荷物に変え別々の利用時の合流場所を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thirty minutes until departure. We will each carry one and move together. If we cannot enter the elevator together, may we meet where it exits?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give your spare time, change to one bag each and ask where to meet if riding separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい、降りた所の通路を塞がない場所でお待ちください。別の階で降りないよう、行き先の階もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes, wait somewhere that does not block the passage at the exit. I will also tell you the floor so you do not get off on different floors.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ホームの階ですね。友人は日本語の表示が読めないので、私が先にボタンの表示を見せて説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 友人が表示を読めないため自分が目的階を説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: The platform floor, correct? My friend cannot read Japanese signs, so I will show and explain the button label first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will explain the destination floor because your friend cannot read the signs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図と同じ番号の階です。お二人とも目的の階を確認してからお入りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It is the floor with the same number as this map. Both confirm the destination floor before entering.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 階の番号を友人に伝えました。荷物は一つずつ持ち、もし別々になったら、その階の広い所で合流します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 目的階を共有し一荷物ずつ移動して必要なら同階で合流すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I told my friend the floor number. We will each carry one bag and, if separated, meet in a spacious area on that floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Share the floor, carry one bag each and decide to meet on the same floor if needed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: エレベーターはこの通路の先です。お二人の荷物に気を付けてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: The elevator is at the end of this passage. Proceed carefully with both of your bags.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転入のご相談ですね。受付番号はお取りになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are consulting about moving in, correct? Have you taken a queue number?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この番号を取りました。住所の手続きと健康保険について聞きたいんですが、同じ番号で待っていていいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転入と保険を一つの受付番号で待てるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I took this number. I want to ask about address procedures and health insurance. Can I wait for both with the same number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether one queue number covers moving-in and insurance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この番号は住所担当の受付です。保険については、現在のご加入状況を担当へ伝えて相談しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: This number is for the address desk. For insurance, tell the staff your current enrolment status and consult them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 前の仕事を辞めてから引っ越しました。新しい会社では保険の説明を受けたところで、何が済んだかよく分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前職退職と新勤務先説明後の加入手続き状態が不明と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I moved after leaving my previous job. I have just had the insurance explanation at the new company, and do not really know which steps are complete.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your enrolment procedure status after leaving the old job and the new employer's explanation is unclear. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 加入状況が分かる会社の案内などはお持ちですか。ここでどの保険になるか決めず、保険担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have company information showing your enrolment status? We will check with insurance staff rather than decide your insurance here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: メールがあります。個人の番号も書いてあるので、受付の前で読み上げるより、担当の方へ画面を見せたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社メールを担当へ直接提示し番号を公開で読み上げたくないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an email. It includes a personal number, so I would rather show the screen directly to the staff than read it aloud in front of reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to show the company email directly to staff rather than read the number aloud publicly. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へ直接お見せください。先に住所の相談をし、その後、保険の窓口へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Show it directly to the staff. First discuss your address, then we will direct you to the insurance desk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 順番が分かりました。保険の番号をもう一枚先に取ると、住所の手続き中に呼ばれそうなので、後で案内を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 窓口の順序を理解し保険番号の先取りを控えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the order. If I take another insurance number now, I might be called while doing the address procedure, so I will ask for directions afterwards.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Understand desk order and refrain from taking an insurance number in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その進め方で結構です。住所の受付が終わりましたら、こちらの係員へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That is fine. When the address reception is finished, speak to the attendant here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まずこの番号で転入を相談します。終わってから保険の案内を受け、会社のメールを担当へ見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所の相談後に保険窓口の案内を受けメールを提示すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: First I will consult about moving in with this number. Afterwards I will get insurance directions and show the staff my company email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide to seek insurance directions after the address consultation and show the email. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、今の番号を持って住所担当の席でお待ちください。保険についてのご希望も伝えておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then keep your current number and wait by the address desk. We will also pass on your wish to discuss insurance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の変更についてですね。予約票の内容を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You want to change a booking, correct? May I ask what is on the booking slip?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 金曜日の午後に予約がありますが、勤務が変わって来られなくなりました。月曜日へ移せるか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 勤務変更で予約日を移したいと希望日時を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have a booking on Friday afternoon, but my work shift changed and I can no longer come. I would like to ask whether it can move to Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Give the desired new date because a work change prevents attending the booking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この票には「書類受取り」とあります。診察の予約とは別ですが、変更したいのはこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This slip says “document collection”. It is separate from a consultation booking. Is this what you want to change?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そうでした。前の診察で頼んだ書類を受け取る日です。月曜日に診察を受け直すという意味ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約は診察ではなく依頼書類の受取だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is right. It is the day to collect documents requested during my previous consultation. I do not mean having another medical consultation on Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Correct yourself that the booking is to collect requested documents, not see the doctor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 承知しました。書類を受け取れる日時を担当へ確認します。提出先の期限はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. We will check available collection dates with the staff. Is there a submission deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 火曜日までに会社へ出します。月曜の受取りが難しい場合は、会社に期限の相談も必要になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 会社の提出期限と受取延期なら会社相談が必要と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I must submit them to my company by Tuesday. If Monday collection is difficult, I will need to discuss the deadline with my company too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain the company's deadline and the need to consult it if collection is delayed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当へその期限も伝えます。書類の完成連絡は、すでにお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will also tell the staff that deadline. Have you already received notice that the documents are ready?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: まだです。予約票があるので完成していると思っていましたが、完成の確認も一緒にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 完成連絡はなく完成と受取日時を両方確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Not yet. I assumed they were ready because I had a booking slip. Please check readiness too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say there is no completion notice and ask to check both readiness and collection time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。完成状況と受取日時を確認して折り返します。今の金曜日の扱いも、その際にご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. We will check readiness and collection time and call back. We will also explain what happens to the current Friday booking then.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、書類の完成と月曜の受取りを確認してください。返事が来るまでは会社に月曜に受け取れると約束しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 担当回答まで受取日を会社へ約束せず照会を待つと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then please check whether the documents are ready and Monday collection is possible. Until the reply, I will not promise my company I can collect them on Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for the inquiry reply without promising the company a collection day beforehand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご依頼を承りました。担当から折り返す番号を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your request. Please let us confirm the number the staff should call back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車の紛失についてですね。ご自身の自転車でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reporting a missing bicycle, correct? Is it your own bicycle?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人から借りています。今朝駐輪場に停めて、夕方戻ったらありませんでした。管理者には、移動していないと言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた自転車が不在で管理者の移動なしという回答を報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I borrowed it from a friend. I parked it in the cycle park this morning and it was gone when I returned in the evening. The manager said they had not moved it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that the borrowed bicycle is missing and the manager said it was not moved. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 所有されているご友人へは連絡しましたか。登録情報などが分かると確認に役立ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you contacted the friend who owns it? Registration details would help us check.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ怖くて連絡できていません。でも自分のものではないので、友人に事情を話して登録の資料をもらいたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人へ未連絡の不安を述べ所有者へ事情と登録資料を頼みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have been too scared to contact them yet. But it is not mine, so I want to explain the circumstances and ask my friend for registration documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain anxiety about not yet contacting the owner and ask to obtain registration documents after explaining. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 借りていたことと最後に停めた状況を、ご自身から説明してください。友人への連絡を待つ間、車体の特徴も伺えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Explain yourself that you borrowed it and how you last parked it. While waiting for your friend, we can also ask about the bicycle's features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 銀色で、かごの前に緑のひもがあります。借りるときに撮った写真は、私の携帯に残っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車体の特徴と借りた際の写真があると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is silver, with a green cord at the front of the basket. I still have the photo I took when borrowing it on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the bicycle and say you have a photo from when you borrowed it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見せてください。鍵はかけていましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the photo. Did you lock it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: かけました。鍵は今も持っています。友人にはこの後連絡し、登録の名義と番号を教えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 施錠と手元の鍵を示し友人から名義番号を聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I still have the key. I will contact my friend after this and ask the registered name and number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: State it was locked, show the key and say you will ask your friend the registered name and number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 所有者の情報と、お客様が実際に見たことは分けて伺います。名義をお客様のお名前として記入しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will ask separately about the owner's information and what you actually saw. Do not enter your own name as the registered owner.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。私は借りていた人として状況を説明します。友人の登録情報を確認できたら、改めてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分は借用者として見た状況を伝え所有者情報は確認後に追加すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will explain the situation as the borrower. Once I confirm my friend's registration information, I will provide it separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Describe what you saw as the borrower and decide to add owner details after confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、停めた時刻と場所から伺います。借りる際の写真もご用意ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let us start with the time and place you parked it. Have the borrowing photo ready too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 保管しているお荷物のお受け取りですね。こちらは代引きの扱いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are collecting a parcel we are holding, correct? This is cash on delivery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通知を持って来ましたが、私は何も注文していません。支払う前に、荷物の差出人を確認してもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 注文の心当たりがない代引き荷物の差出人を支払前に確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought the notice, but have not ordered anything. May I check the sender before paying?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check the sender of an unfamiliar cash-on-delivery parcel before payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 伝票の差出人名と金額を一緒にご確認ください。ご家族が注文された可能性はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check the sender and amount on the label with us. Might a family member have ordered it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 母と暮らしているので、その可能性はあります。でも、この店名だけでは分かりません。母に電話して確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同居の母が注文した可能性はあるが店名だけでは分からず本人に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I live with my mother, so that is possible. But the shop name alone does not tell me. I want to call my mother to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say your cohabiting mother may have ordered it but the shop name is insufficient, and you want to ask her. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認してからお知らせください。お荷物は、まだこちらでお預かりしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us know after checking. We are still holding the parcel here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 電話しましたが出ませんでした。母からの贈り物だと聞いていた別の荷物と、同じ物かも分かりません。今は支払わずに待ちたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 母が電話に出ず別の贈り物との同一性も不明なため未払いで待つ希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I called, but she did not answer. I also do not know whether this is the same as another parcel she told me was a gift. I would like to wait without paying now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say your mother did not answer and identity with another gift is unknown, so you want to wait unpaid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: では、お受け取りの扱いを決める前に、担当へ確認しましょう。お母様には何をお聞きになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then let us check with the staff before deciding how to handle collection. What will you ask your mother?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 注文した店名と、この金額の支払いが残っているかを聞きます。通知を見せますが、荷物を受け取ったとは伝えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 店名と残る支払を母へ聞き通知だけを示して未受取と説明すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The shop she ordered from and whether payment of this amount is still due. I will show the notice, but will not tell her I have collected the parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask your mother the shop and outstanding payment, show only the notice and say it is uncollected. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できない場合の対応も担当がご案内します。ご希望を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The staff will also explain what to do if you cannot confirm it. Please tell them your preference.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 母の返事を待ってから判断したいです。返事が遅くなるかもしれないので、保管期限と今の段階でできる手続きを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返事後に判断したいと伝え保管期限と現段階の手続きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I want to decide after my mother replies. Her reply may take time, so please tell me the storage deadline and what procedures are possible now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you want to decide after a reply and ask the holding deadline and procedures possible now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まだ受け取りもお支払いもされていない状態として、担当へご相談を引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-09215-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will hand the inquiry to the staff as a parcel neither collected nor paid for yet.
